title: Unicyclic Tree-Absorption Reduction
statement:
Let a finite fiber-coherence CSP have a connected variable–constraint
incidence graph with exactly one cycle. Compute the exact CC12 messages on
every tree attached to the unique cycle. For each cycle variable \(t\), let
\(D_t\) be the surviving domain. For every cycle constraint \(h\), whose two
cycle variables are \(t,u\), define
\[
R_h\subseteq D_t\times D_u
\]
to consist of the pairs extendable through \(h\) and all tree branches
attached to \(h\). Then the original CSP has a coherent section if and only
if the resulting binary CSP on the unique cycle has a solution.

title: Variable-Feedback Conditioning Theorem
statement:
Let \(S\) be a set of variable nodes in a finite fiber-coherence CSP such
that deleting \(S\) from the incidence graph leaves a forest. The CSP has a
coherent section if and only if some assignment to the variables in \(S\)
leaves a satisfiable forest CSP after restricting every incident
constraint to that assignment.

title: Twisted-Cycle K4-Free Realization
statement:
Let \(n\ge7\) and let \(\sigma_0,\dots,\sigma_{n-1}\in\{0,1\}\).
There is a finite \(K_4\)-free graph with stable parts
\(P_i=\{p_i^0,p_i^1\}\), indices modulo \(n\), whose nonempty fibers are:
\[
e_i^b=p_i^b p_{i+1}^{\,b\oplus\sigma_i},
\qquad
f_i^b=p_i^b p_{i+2}^{\,b\oplus\sigma_i\oplus\sigma_{i+1}}.
\]
Its realized triangle types are exactly
\[
h_i=\{P_iP_{i+1},P_{i+1}P_{i+2},P_iP_{i+2}\},
\]
and the coherence relation at \(h_i\) is
\[
b_{i+1}=b_i\oplus\sigma_i.
\]

title: Unicyclic Fixed-Point Criterion
statement:
In the binary cycle produced by UC01, enumerate the cycle variables as
\(t_0,\dots,t_{m-1}\) and let
\(R_i\subseteq D_i\times D_{i+1}\), indices modulo \(m\), be the projected
relations. The original CSP is coherent if and only if the relational
composition
\[
R_0\circ R_1\circ\cdots\circ R_{m-1}
\subseteq D_0\times D_0
\]
contains a fixed point \((x,x)\).

title: Polynomial-Time Unicyclic Coherence
statement:
A finite fiber-coherence CSP whose incidence graph has at most one cycle per
connected component can be decided, and a coherent section reconstructed,
in time polynomial in the explicitly listed domain and relation sizes.

title: Feedback-Set Coherence Algorithm
statement:
Under UC02, a section can be decided in
\[
O\!\left(
  \prod_{s\in S}|F_s|
  \cdot \operatorname{poly}(\text{explicit CSP size})
\right)
\]
time. Consequently finite fiber coherence is fixed-parameter tractable in
the variable-feedback number together with the maximum fiber size.

title: Feedback-Assignment Refutation Certificate
statement:
If a finite fiber-coherence CSP is incoherent and \(S\) is a variable
feedback set, then incoherence has a certificate consisting of, for every
assignment to \(S\), one CC12 empty-message certificate in the restricted
forest. At most
\[
\prod_{s\in S}|F_s|
\]
forest certificates are required.

title: Permutation-Cycle Monodromy Theorem
statement:
Suppose the projected cycle relations in UC04 are bijections
\(\pi_i:D_i\to D_{i+1}\). Then coherent sections are in bijection with the
fixed points of the monodromy permutation
\[
\Pi=\pi_{m-1}\circ\cdots\circ\pi_0:D_0\to D_0.
\]
In particular, the number of coherent sections equals
\(|\operatorname{Fix}(\Pi)|\).

title: No Third Obstruction at Cycle Rank One
statement:
Every finite incoherent fiber-coherence CSP with a connected unicyclic
incidence graph has an exact certificate of one of two kinds:
1. **support-pruning failure:** tree absorption empties a variable domain or
   a projected cycle relation;
2. **cycle fixed-point failure:** all absorbed domains and relations are
   nonempty, but the cycle relation composition has no fixed point.
There is no third obstruction mechanism at incidence cycle rank one.

title: Twisted-Cycle XOR Criterion
statement:
The twisted-cycle construction UC03 has exactly two coherent sections when
\[
\sigma_0\oplus\cdots\oplus\sigma_{n-1}=0,
\]
and no coherent section when the xor is \(1\).

title: Arbitrarily Large Minimal Pure-Cycle Frustration
statement:
For every integer \(n\ge7\), there is a finite \(K_4\)-free
fiber-coherence system with exactly \(n\) constraints that is incoherent,
every proper constraint subsystem is coherent, every fiber value survives
support pruning, and the incidence graph has exactly one cycle.

title: Arc Consistency Is Insufficient in K4-Free Fiber Systems
statement:
Enforcing support consistency on every variable–constraint incidence does
not decide finite \(K_4\)-free fiber coherence, even when every domain has
size two and the incidence graph has one cycle.

title: Support and Monodromy Frustration Are Orthogonal
statement:
\(K_4\)-free fiber coherence has two independently necessary obstruction
families:
1. arbitrarily large Berge-acyclic support-intersection cores from CC06;
2. arbitrarily large support-consistent unicyclic monodromy cores from UC11.
Neither cycle detection alone nor support pruning alone classifies finite
minimal incoherence.

title: Finite Minimal-Core Cycle-Rank Trichotomy
statement:
Let \(K\) be an inclusion-minimal finite incoherent fiber CSP.
Exactly one of the following structural branches applies:
1. its incidence graph is a forest, and CC12 supplies an acyclic
   support-pruning certificate;
2. its incidence graph is unicyclic, and UC09 supplies either support
   pruning or a fixed-point-free cycle certificate;
3. its incidence graph has cycle rank at least two.
Thus a genuinely new mixed obstruction family, if one exists, must first
occur in the multicyclic branch.

title: Refined Finite-Fiber #595 Close Trichotomy
Page-Free Refined Close Trichotomy
statement:
The page-free unary-homogeneous induced witness from HG21 satisfies the
same four-way finite-fiber close split as UC15.

title: Bounded-Feedback Exact Certification
statement:
If every finite minimal incoherence core in a class of fiber CSPs has a
variable feedback set of size at most \(r\) and all fibers have size at
most \(d\), then incoherence in that class has a certificate consisting of
at most \(d^r\) acyclic empty-message proofs and is decidable in
\(O(d^r\operatorname{poly}(N))\) time.

title: Bounded Feedback Does Not Give a Helly Bound
statement:
Bounded incidence feedback number does not imply any bounded local
coherence test. This already fails at feedback number zero.

title: Multicycle Interaction Quotient Target
Permutation-Cycle Realization Generalization Target
statement:
Determine which finite permutation-labeled cycle CSPs admit stable-partition
realizations by \(K_4\)-free graphs with no extra realized triangle types.
The binary xor family UC03 realizes the two-element permutation group.
Seek realizations for larger domains and characterize the graph-theoretic
restrictions on the monodromy permutation.
